stem:
The diagram shows Raghav's rectangular courtyard as a closed figure. Side lengths are marked in metres.

What is the perimeter of the courtyard?

teacher.key_rationale: Perimeter adds the boundary once: 7+3+7+3=20 m. 10 m adds length and width once only. 21 m is the area. 17 m uses an incomplete boundary total.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote grid quadrilateral into a labeled 7 m by 3 m rectangle; stem refers to the diagram.
